alt: Line chart of weekly engagement events from 2021 to 2025, with a dashed eight-week rolling mean and 13 marked unusual weeks. The sharpest peak is about 2,960 events in January 2025.
caption: Weekly engagement events from 2021 to 2025, with 13 unusual weeks marked. Five of the 13 fall in January, and the largest is about 2,960 events in January 2025. The last week of data, starting 5 October 2025, is excluded as a known data-boundary artefact.
